name: Faulty Terminal
description: Full-size WebGL2 background of a glitching CRT terminal grid with scanlines, flicker, glow, curvature, mouse reactive light and click glitch or degauss effects.
contents: Container div filling its parent with an absolutely positioned WebGL canvas
behavior: Renders a grid of blocks, dots or characters (digits and letters) with animated noise, scanlines, flicker and glitch
Intro animation plays on load for about 2 seconds unless disabled
Pointer position adds a glow and displacement across the whole window, and clicks trigger a glitch or degauss effect (up to 4 at once)
Rendering pauses when offscreen or the tab is hidden, and reduced motion preference is respected
Resizes with its container, pixel ratio capped at 2
editableByProps: Tint color, brightness, glow, vignette and light mode
Glyph style, grid density, digit size and scale
Animation speed, pause, glitch, flicker, noise, scramble and persistence
Scanlines, curvature, chromatic aberration and dither
Mouse reaction, mouse glow and click effect
Intro animation, pixel ratio, random seed via variation, container class and style

needsCodeEdit.change: Change the character set shown in characters mode
needsCodeEdit.where: FONT constant at the top of the file

needsCodeEdit.change: Change intro length or max simultaneous clicks
Limit pointer tracking to the component instead of the window
needsCodeEdit.where: pointermove and pointerdown listeners in the main useEffect

fixed: Requires WebGL2, renders nothing if unavailable or shader compile fails
Fills its parent, so the parent needs a defined height and position
Listens to pointermove and pointerdown on window and pointerleave on the document element while mounted, so pointer effects work even outside the container
Canvas is aria-hidden and purely decorative
Should be placed behind content with its own z-index since it has no content slot

options.look: Digits and letters like terminal output
